## 主张 Claim

普查（Counted：每步活跃的关系项被不重复地列出，所以每步只有有限多个活跃）与有界传递（Transmitting：世系在一个界内传递每个依存）也是世界的前提。蕴含：活动需要支持推出有储备承载（零储备，Dependent.carried）；每个关系项体现推出生起者体现（Embodied.arising）；活动可判定的有限世界有普查（Finite.counted）；只有活跃者取用且只取用所汲取的、并且流耗散时，在被围住的步上只有活跃者给予，因为那里给予需要取用（acting_across），所以每步都被围住时只有活跃者给予（acting_of_enclosed），有限世界的每一步都被围住（Finite.enclosed、Finite.acting）。其余八个前提——活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用且只取用所汲取的、耗散、体现、普查、有界传递（premises）——彼此独立：对每一个，都有一个世界满足其余七个而不满足它（independent）：自身水平不足以支持其活动的关系项（strained）、Handing 的两侧没有流（unbalanced）、一个从不活跃的关系项给予无限多个关系项而一个活跃者取回同样多（scatter）、吃者取用它并不汲取的食物（morsel）、持有者取走储存的一个单位再还回（keeping）、立着而从不活跃的关系项（latent）、无限多个同时活跃的关系项（multitude）、亲代烧燃料给子代以水平而子代开始依存于亲代、亲代自身从未有这一依存（novel）。所以没有一个前提由其余推出（none_follows）。平衡另有一个见证，取用与耗散在其中每步起约束：持有者每步取用自身一个单位而不给予，两侧的家族每步封闭且被取用（draining_but）。不满足普查与不满足只有活跃者给予的两个世界都是无限的，与上面的蕴含一致。始终活跃的互利者满足全部八个（mutualism_premised）；有限、活动可判定且满足八个的世界中，生起与止息都不再复现，证明用到其中的平衡、耗散与体现（premised_rests）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / A census (Counted: the relata active at each step are listed, each once, so finitely many are active at each step) and bounded transmission (Transmitting: descent transmits every dependence within one bound) are premises of worlds too. What follows: activity needing support makes activity carried, by the zero reserve (Dependent.carried); every relatum embodied makes whatever arises embodied (Embodied.arising); a finite world whose activity is decided has a census (Finite.counted); and where only active relata take, and only from what they draw on, and the flow dissipates, only active relata give across an enclosed step, since giving needs uptake there (acting_across), so where every step is enclosed only active relata give (acting_of_enclosed), every step of a finite world being enclosed (Finite.enclosed, Finite.acting). The remaining eight premises, activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking and only from what they draw on, dissipation, embodiment, a census and bounded transmission (premises), are independent: for each, a world meets the other seven and not it (independent). The worlds are a relatum whose standing does not support its activity (strained), the sides of Handing with no flow (unbalanced), a relatum never active giving to infinitely many while an active one takes as much back (scatter), an eater taking a morsel it does not draw on (morsel), a keeper taking its store's unit and giving it back (keeping), a relatum standing and never active (latent), infinitely many relata active at once (multitude), and a parent burning fuel to give a child its standing while the child comes to depend on the parent, a dependence the parent never had (novel). So no premise follows from the others (none_follows). For balance there is a second witness in which taking and dissipation bind at every step: the holder takes its own unit and gives nothing, and the family of both sides is closed and taken from at every step (draining_but). The worlds failing a census and failing only active relata giving are infinite, as the implications require. Mutualists active throughout meet all eight (mutualism_premised), and in a finite world whose activity is decided and which meets the eight, neither arising nor ceasing recurs, the proof using balance, dissipation and embodiment among them (premised_rests). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 蕴含：Finite.counted 与 premised_rests 要求每步每个关系项是否活跃可判定（核心是构造性的；经典地总是如此）；acting_of_enclosed 要求每一步都被围住。 / What follows: Finite.counted and premised_rests need whether each relatum is active at each step to be decidable (the core is constructive; classically it always is); acting_of_enclosed needs every step to be enclosed.
- 独立与全部满足是关于具体世界的陈述，不加前提。 / Independence and meeting all of them are statements about particular worlds, with no premise.

计划对“完整”的第三条读法要求每个动力学前提划出整个空间的真部分。P22 对七个前提给出了这一点；本结果补上普查与有界传递，并更进一步：前提不仅各自偶然，而且其余八个相对于彼此独立，在这八个之中没有一个藏在其余之中。八个是 P22 的七个去掉储备承载（由活动需要支持推出），加上普查与有界传递；连同储备承载与生起者体现这两个较弱的形式，世界层面共陈述十个前提。作者的读法（AI 论证）：蕴含显示哪些前提只是另一前提的较弱形式（有储备承载、生起者体现）或在活动可判定的有限世界中自动成立（普查；不给可判定性而对每个有限世界要求它，就蕴含排中律），以及耗散与只有活跃者取用怎样在被围住的步上带来只有活跃者给予；独立性显示剩下的每一个都是对世界的独立限定。有限、被围住与可判定性不在这八个之中，而静止定理正是以它们为转折；加上它们，只有活跃者给予与普查就推出。多个见证没有流，关于流的四个前提（只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用、耗散、有界传递）在其中空成立：strained、unbalanced、latent、multitude 与互利者没有流，scatter 没有被围住的步，morsel 没有依存、给予与世系，keeping 的水平不变；只有 novel 中其余七个都起约束。这足以证明独立；平衡另有取用与耗散每步起约束的见证（draining_but）。相对于另一读法陈述的前提——延续关系（Identity）、更新关系（Generation）、衰减的储备（Reserve）、条件家族（Flow、Dissipation）——没有在这里映射；流中每个参与者只列一次是表示的条件，不是世界的条件。前提的名称与这些世界的名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定。 / The plan's third part of completeness asks that each dynamical premise carve a proper part of the whole space. P22 gave this for seven premises; this result adds the census and bounded transmission and goes further: the premises are not only each contingent, the remaining eight are independent relative to one another, none hidden in the others among these eight. The eight are P22's seven without the reserve carrying activity, which follows from activity needing support, together with the census and bounded transmission; with the two weaker forms, a reserve carrying activity and embodied arising, ten premises are stated of worlds. The author's reading (an AI argument): the implications show which premises are only weaker forms of another (activity carried, whatever arises embodied) or hold automatically in finite worlds whose activity is decided (a census; asking it of every finite world without decidability implies excluded middle), and how dissipation and only active relata taking bring only active relata giving across enclosed steps; independence shows that each of the rest is a separate restriction of worlds. Finiteness, enclosure and decidability are not among the eight, though the rest theorems turn on them; with them added, only active relata giving and a census follow. Several witnesses have no flow, so the four premises about the flow (only active relata giving, only active relata taking, dissipation, bounded transmission) hold vacuously there: strained, unbalanced, latent, multitude and the mutualists have no flow, scatter has no enclosed step, morsel has no dependence, giving or descent, and keeping's levels are steady; only in novel do all the other seven bind. That suffices for independence; for balance a second witness has taking and dissipation binding at every step (draining_but). Premises stated relative to a further reading, a continuation relation (Identity), a renewal relation (Generation), a decaying reserve (Reserve) or a family of conditions (Flow, Dissipation), are not mapped here; that each formation taking part is listed once in a flow is a condition of the representation, not of the world. The names of the premises and of these worlds are the AI's formulations, and Ren's to choose.

相对于另一读法的前提（延续关系、更新关系、衰减的储备、条件家族）的地图；满足全部八个且每个都起约束的世界；名称（Ren）。在普查与被围住之下的静止已由 P25 与 P26 回答（continued-change-needs-openness）。 / A map of the premises stated relative to a further reading (a continuation relation, a renewal relation, a decaying reserve, a family of conditions); a world meeting all eight with each binding; names (Ren). Rest under censuses and enclosure is answered by P25 and P26 (continued-change-needs-openness).
